Burkina Faso.title: Flow of underage children to gold mining sites: In Dédougou, “Polisi I Nisonisa” raises awareness
Burkina Faso.summary: Launched in March 2026 in the Bankui region, Polisi I Nisonisa, which means "the police, my neighbour" in Bwamu, is a community policing initiative that focuses on dialogue and proximity to enhance security. As part of this approach, its teams visit neighbourhoods and public places to engage with local residents about their security concerns. .

For the time being, no official casualty figures have been released. Niger.title: Nigeria signs a new military agreement with Cameroon, Niger and Chad
